🌍 Flag facts
🪨
The grey shape is a latte stone, a stone pillar the ancient Chamorro people used to hold up their houses.
⭐
The white star stands for the islands as part of the United States.
💐
The wreath is a mwarmwar, a traditional Carolinian head garland of flowers.
🏝️
The Northern Mariana Islands are a chain of 14 islands in the western Pacific.
